parameters.content:
## Reusable Subworkflow

**Purpose:** Classify inbound support messages and draft a reply.

**Input fields:** `ticket_id`, `customer_name`, `customer_email`, `subject`, `body`, `channel`

**Output fields:** `category`, `confidence`, `ai_summary`, `ai_response`, `priority`

Uses `$vars.OPENAI_MODEL` and `$vars.CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD`.

nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point for parent workflows (email / webhook / manual).

nodes.name: Validate Inbound Payload
nodes.notes: Guards against empty payloads before spending OpenAI tokens.

assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value: You are an expert customer support triage engine. Classify the email into exactly one category: Billing, Technical Support, Sales, Refund, General Inquiry. Return strict JSON with keys: category (string), confidence (number 0-100), priority (Low|Medium|High|Urgent), ai_summary (string <= 280 chars), reasoning (string).

nodes.name: OpenAI · Classify Message

parameters.jsonBody: ={{JSON.stringify({ model: $vars.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.1, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.user_prompt } ] })}}

nodes.notes: Header Auth value should be: Bearer <OPENAI_API_KEY>

assignments.name: reply_system
assignments.value: You are a professional, empathetic customer support agent. Write a clear email reply. Never invent account balances, refund amounts, or policy exceptions. If information is missing, ask concise clarifying questions. Return strict JSON with keys: subject (string), body (string), confidence (number 0-100).

assignments.name: reply_user

parameters.jsonBody: ={{JSON.stringify({ model: $vars.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.4, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.reply_system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.reply_user } ] })}}

nodes.name: Assemble AI Result
nodes.notes: Averages classification + reply confidence; compares to $vars.CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.
